manifest.name: BANKSY niches
manifest.author: PointillViz reference tools
manifest.description: Tissue niches from each cell's expression and its neighbourhood's, by the BANKSY method.
manifest.long_description: Joins every cell's expression to that of its spatial neighbours, as BANKSY does, and clusters the result into niches with the authors' Leiden recipe or with k-means. The niches are painted on the map, with their cell types, marker genes and a downloadable list of every cell's niche.
manifest.citation: Singhal V, Chou N, Lee J, et al. BANKSY unifies cell typing and tissue domain segmentation for scalable spatial omics data analysis. Nat Genet 56, 431-441 (2024).

params.name: clustering
params.label: Clustering
params.help:
Leiden finds as many niches as the resolution calls for, on a graph of cells that share neighbours.
k-means divides the cells into exactly the number of niches you ask for.

params.name: resolution
params.label: Resolution (Leiden)
params.help: Leiden only. Higher values give more, smaller niches; lower values give fewer, larger ones.

params.name: n_niches
params.label: Niches (k-means)
params.help:
k-means only: how many niches to divide the tissue into.
If two niches share their marker genes and cell types, try fewer.

params.name: lambda
params.label: Neighbourhood weight (λ)
params.help:
How much a cell's neighbourhood counts against its own expression.
0.8 finds tissue domains; 0.2 finds spatially informed cell types; 0 ignores space.

params.name: k_geom
params.label: Spatial neighbours (k)
params.help: How many nearest cells make a neighbourhood. The gradient features use twice as many.

params.name: agf
params.label: Include gradients (AGF)
params.help: Adds BANKSY's azimuthal Gabor filter, which responds where expression changes across a neighbourhood, as at a border.

params.name: n_genes
params.label: Variable genes
params.help: How many of the most variable genes to use. More genes take longer.

params.name: n_pcs
params.label: Principal components
params.help: How many principal components of the joint matrix the clustering sees.

params.name: smooth
params.label: Smooth labels
params.help: Gives a cell the niche held by more than half of itself and its 15 nearest cells, repeated until nothing changes (BANKSY's smoothLabels).
